item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Shows `JSONAdapter(use_native_function_calling=False)` with `dspy.ToolCalls` and asserts `lm.calls[0][\"response_format\"] == {\"type\": \"json_object\"}`."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Uses the exact signature fields `question`, `tools: list[dspy.Tool]`, `answer`, and `tool_calls: dspy.ToolCalls`, and calls `dspy.Predict` with a real `dspy.Tool` while native function calling is disabled."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Stubbed LM returns both `answer` and `tool_calls` keys, with `tool_calls` containing an empty `tool_calls` list; the code asserts parsed `pred.answer == \"sunny\"` and empty tool calls."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"The custom LM advertises both `supported_params = {\"response_format\"}` and `supports_response_schema = True`, isolating the fallback to the disabled native tool-calling path."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
